title: The stealthy journey of nanoplastics in bivalves: accumulation dynamics and toxic burden
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4748-4767
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00673B, Critical Review
Yuntian Shi, Kangping Jiao, Li'ang Li, Wenbo Guo, Mohamed H. Abo-Raya, Jae-Seong Lee, Rim EL Amouri, Menghong Hu, Youji Wang
The strong filter-feeding capacity of bivalves makes them more prone to accumulating nanoplastic particles from their environment, posing a threat to aquaculture and food safety.
